prompt:
Style: a hand-painted sky backdrop for a stylized 3D fantasy role-playing game, used as a wide painted sky dome behind a 3D harbour scene. Only sky: no land, no sea, no islands, no hills, no buildings, no lighthouse, no birds, no sun disc. Digital painting with bold, smooth brush strokes and simplified, chunky, slightly exaggerated shapes, as in the painted skies of stylized online role-playing games: clean painterly gradients, clearly shaped clouds, no photographic detail, no fine noise, no lens effects. Warm, saturated colours with hue-shifted shading.
Composition: the bottom edge of the image is the horizon line. Along the bottom sixth runs a glowing band of orange and warm yellow afterglow (the sun has just set slightly left of centre); above it the sky turns rose and lilac, deepening to deep blue-violet at the top edge. Large stylized clouds in the middle and upper part, painted as soft rounded swirls and stacked puffs with clear outlines: undersides lit orange and pink, tops violet-blue, a few long thin cloud streaks low above the horizon. The first small stars as single bright points in the upper quarter only. The colours at the left and right edges match.
The sky belongs to this scene (context only, paint nothing but its sky): Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Not a photograph, not a realistic 3D render, not a postcard.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.

Texture sheet for a stylized 3D fantasy role-playing game whose world is covered with hand-painted textures. Nine square surface textures arranged in an exact 3 by 3 grid of equal squares, separated by straight, even gutters of pure black (#000000), with a pure black border around the whole sheet. Every square is filled edge to edge with one flat surface material, seen straight on (orthographic, no perspective, no objects, no frame, no vignette, no cast shadows).
Technique: hand-painted diffuse textures as made for stylized online role-playing games: digital painting on a tablet with bold, clean brush strokes and chunky, simplified, slightly exaggerated shapes. The light is painted into the colour: every stone, slate and plank has a warm light upper edge, a darker lower edge and dark painted crevices and joints (painted ambient occlusion), so the surface reads as three-dimensional without any lighting. No specular highlights, no gloss, no photographic detail, no fine noise or grain. Warm, saturated colours with hue-shifted shading: shadows lean to violet and blue, highlights to warm yellow and peach. Even overall brightness across each square (no light falloff across the square), so that each texture tiles seamlessly: the pattern continues across the left/right and top/bottom edges without seams.
Row 1, left to right: (1) quay paving: large irregular rounded flagstones in warm grey with ochre and lilac tints, about 4 by 4 stones per square, dark joints between them, each stone with a light top-left rim and a dark bottom-right edge, a few cracks; (2) rough fieldstone wall: rounded stones of varied size in about 5 horizontal courses, warm grey and beige with lilac tints, deep dark mortar gaps; (3) roof slates: overlapping rectangular slate shingles in 6 horizontal rows, slate blue to violet, each row with a light lower edge and a dark shadow under the row above.
Row 2: (4) wooden planks running horizontally, 5 planks per square, warm honey-brown wood with painted grain strokes, dark gaps between the planks, light worn edges, a few nail heads; (5) the same planks in dark reddish-brown aged wood; (6) cliff rock: large chunky angular rock facets in warm grey-brown, light top planes and dark cracks, like a stylized cliff face.
Row 3: (7) lush stylized grass painted as soft overlapping clumps and short strokes in yellow-green and deep green, a few lighter blades, no flowers; (8) warm light beach sand with soft painted ripples and a few small pebbles; (9) whitewashed lime plaster, off-white with soft painted patches, faint cracks and slightly darker weathered spots.
The materials are for a small stone fishing harbour on a fictional island in a northern sea (only the materials, not the scene).
Not a photograph, not a photo-scanned texture, not a realistic 3D render, not pixel art.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.
